live_command: tools/dev/sandbox.sh up && tools/dev/sandbox.sh status && SB="$(cd "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/rhythm-dev-sandbox" && pwd -P)" && cd apps/api_server && RHYTHM_LIVE_E2E=1 RHYTHM_LIVE_E2E_ISOLATED=1 DB_PATH="$SB/rhythm.db" RHYTHM_SANDBOX_DIR="$SB" RHYTHM_LIVE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:4098 RHYTHM_LIVE_ENGINE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:4097 npx vitest run src/__tests__/live_artifacts_mcp_live_e2e.test.ts --no-file-parallelism; cd ../.. && tools/dev/sandbox.sh down

criteria.text: Add exactly five tools: rhythm_list_live_artifacts, rhythm_get_live_artifact, rhythm_create_live_artifact, rhythm_update_live_artifact_state, rhythm_update_live_artifact_bundle. Register them once.
Route all five to hosted RHYTHM_API_URL, never RHYTHM_AGENT_URL, using existing user-bound bearer token. Never log or return token/internal storage paths.

Schemas expose only the AV-02 public contract including create bundle/state/visibility/collaborators/declared capabilities, list/search, get, and independent expectedStateRevision/expectedBundleRevision updates.
Propagate 404/409/410 safely and clearly, including current public revision on conflicts. Do not hide errors as successful tool results.
Security classification: list/get are external/untrusted reads; create/update are outbound writes using existing exact-payload, user-bound approval/security graph conventions.
criteria.note: Negatives prove the write path fails closed: a denied approval and absent trusted session metadata both refuse with zero mutating calls to the hosted API, and malformed arguments are rejected at the MCP boundary with -32602 before the handler runs. Each asserts the bearer token never appears in the tool result.

criteria.text: Minimal Worship Calendar fixture proves create payload for HTML/CSS/JS plus JSON state and a state CAS update under the same artifact ID.

Focused tests prove endpoint/method/body mapping, bearer forwarding without disclosure, schemas, exact revisions, conflict/deleted errors, security graph classification, and no generic capability/scheduler tool.
Real sandbox engine/MCP live E2E creates Worship Calendar through actual MCP path, performs agent state update, and observes changed fields through hosted-style API contract under the same stable ID.
criteria.test_id: av03-c8: lists the five tools, creates, CAS-updates state, and reads the change back under one ID
criteria.note: GET /opencode/mcp reports tools: [] for EVERY server on this engine build because that array derives from tool.ids() (built-in + plugin tools only); MCP tools are assembled at session-prompt time, so the live test proves listing and invocation through a real engine session instead. The contract harness previously read the AV-02-era HTTP-only live_artifacts_live_e2e.test.ts, which never drives the engine; it now reads live_artifacts_mcp_live_e2e.test.ts and asserts the engine-session markers, the five advertised rhythm_rhythm_* tool names, the create/update_state/get call order, and the explicit state revision 1 then 2.
